Princess Theatres

Written, directed & produced by Cameron Emsley-Drummond

Princess Theatres Documentary

A short documentary about Waterloo’s Princess Theatres, built around a long-form interview with the cinema chain’s CEO. I wrote, directed, and produced it, and assisted with the edit in Adobe Premiere Pro.

I handled production from start to finish: I reached out to the CEO, scheduled the shoot around his availability, wrote the shot list, and led a three-person crew on camera and sound through a single shoot day using Canon DSLRs with boom and wireless mics.

How it was made

Production breakdown
  1. 01

    Securing the interview

    I reached out to the CEO directly and coordinated with him over email to find the shoot day that worked best for his schedule.

  2. 02

    I created the shot list and scheduled the team around that day.

    A three-person crew under my direction: two on cameras, and one on sound with boom and wireless mics.

  4. 04

    One shoot day

    We shot the film in a single day on Canon DSLRs, built around a long-form interview with the CEO.

    I assisted with the edit, shaping the story around that conversation.

03 — Background

About me

Cameron Emsley-Drummond

Marketing · Communications · Content · Production · Film

4th-year Global Business & Digital Arts student at the University of Waterloo — building human-centred stories across marketing, communications, content, and film.

Hi my name is Cameron, and I am driven by my need to create stories that people are able to connect to in as many mediums as I can. Growing up I was inspired by video games like Halo 3 and would write stories set in that world. This was my introduction to writing. As I got older I began to develop an interest in film, having watched Parasite I was incredibly inspired to begin screenwriting. From that point on I began writing screenplays, one eventually garnering awards and was performed as a play. This was a pivotal experience of mine and cemented the truth I have always known, I am wired to create stories.

Through my education I have been looking for other professional outlets to tell stories through, which is where I found and fell in love with marketing. Marketing, to me, is all about creating one grand story that anyone can connect to — the ultimate, but most rewarding, challenge for a writer.

Different formats, same job: find the human story and tell it well.

That instinct now runs through all of my work. At Keplar I wrote blog posts and ghostwrote LinkedIn content, backed by competitor and performance research, that helped lift engagement 85%. At Northbridge Financial I turned complex insurance topics into clear writing for non-expert readers. At UW CUBE and UW Blueprint I run social content end to end, from strategy to filming reels myself. And on the Princess Theatres documentary I wrote, directed, and produced.

Whether it's a campaign, an internal article, a reel, or a short film, I approach it the same way a writer does: who is this for, and what will make them care? Then I check the numbers to see whether it worked.

I am currently in my 4th year as a Global Business and Digital Arts student at the University of Waterloo and have continued to hone my craft as a storyteller in every facet. If you are looking for someone who aims to create unique human-centred experiences, please reach out!
